taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-30, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 74.2 | 15.31 | 15.31
2 | 27.3 | 18.79 | 34.10
3 | 76.3 | 5.06 | 39.16
4 | 96.3 | 4.07 | 43.23
5 | 138.1 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To find the curve-type notation for the given VES data, we examine the resistivity values of the five layers:
- Layer 1 (r1): 74.2 ohm-m
- Layer 2 (r2): 27.3 ohm-m
- Layer 3 (r3): 76.3 ohm-m
- Layer 4 (r4): 96.3 ohm-m
- Layer 5 (r5): 138.1 ohm-m

A curve with 5 layers results in $N-2 = 3$ letters. We analyze groups of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $r_1 = 74.2$, $r_2 = 27.3$, $r_3 = 76.3$.
    Since $74.2 > 27.3 < 76.3$ (decreasing then increasing), the letter is **H**.

2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $r_2 = 27.3$, $r_3 = 76.3$, $r_4 = 96.3$.
    Since $27.3 < 76.3 < 96.3$ (increasing then increasing), the letter is **A**.

3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $r_3 = 76.3$, $r_4 = 96.3$, $r_5 = 138.1$.
    Since $76.3 < 96.3 < 138.1$ (increasing then increasing), the letter is **A**.

Combining these letters in order gives **HAA**.

{"curve_type": "HAA"}
